From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Elliott <sam.elliott@avacloud.com>; Elena Park <elena.park@avacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call MAP draft — owners, SLAs & legal TAT (AvaCloud)

Hi Sam / Elena — thanks for the time today. Quick recap + draft MAP items from our side and proposed owners/TATs so we can lock a target close date.

Call recap (2x reps, brief):
- AvaCloud interested in Redwood Dedicated + Private for regulated workloads; technical eval next week.
- Procurement / legal review and SOC2 evidence checks are the critical path for procurement.
- Target: production pilot by end of Q1; contract signed before year-end preferred by your team.

Draft MAP milestones (proposed owners & SLAs):
1) Commercial terms finalized (pricing, term, seats) — Owner: Ben Carter (Sales) — Target: 3 business days after pricing sign-off.
2) MSA redline first pass — Owner: Redwood Legal (Lauren Bishop) — Target SLA: 3 business days from receipt.
3) DPA & SLA specifics — Owner: Redwood Legal + Security (Lauren to coordinate) — Target: 5 business days for initial alignment.
4) SOC2 evidence & security questionnaire — Owner: Redwood Security (cc: security@redwood.com) — Target: 4 business days to provide artifacts/answers; may require follow-up.
5) Technical POC scheduling & success criteria — Owner: Ben Carter + Marissa Cole — Target: schedule within 7 business days after contract milestones agreed.

Dependencies / notes:
- If your GC wants to redline MSA + DPA in parallel, please confirm point person and preferred file format (we prefer single tracked MS Word doc for MSA).
- Heavier legal escalations beyond standard terms will trigger VP review (Markus Klein).

Attachments: Draft_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (MAP timeline + owner columns).

Next steps (please):
- Sam: confirm who on your side will own legal redlines (GC name & email) and expected internal TAT.
- Elena: if you want a pre-call with our legal today/this week, propose windows and we’ll align.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP file and share a v1 with names once I have your owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole

On Tue, 1 Dec 2026 at 09:05 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Sam — thanks for the clear MAP. Quick additions from sales ops...

Thanks both — happy to own the MSA/DPA/SLA milestone as outlined. High-level approach and internal SLAs: 
- First pass MSA (tracked changes) from Redwood Legal: 3 business days from receipt of your redline/requests.
- First pass DPA and SLA language (if separate): 5 business days for initial comments; security artifacts follow the SOC2 packet schedule (we'll provide links to the evidence).
- If AvaCloud sends parallel heavy redlines (>15 substantive open commercial/legal points), please trigger escalation to Markus (cc'd) for exceptions or commercial trade-offs — that will add review time.

Preferred process to reduce churn:
1) Exchange a single tracked MSA doc (we prefer Word .docx).
2) Each side makes consolidated redlines rather than multiple fragment rounds.
3) Redwood will surface any non-standard clauses with a short rationale note (1-2 lines) to speed negotiation.

Attachments: MSA_Redline_Guidelines.pdf (internal checklist + examples of fast-resolve language).

I'll commit to the 3bd/5bd SLAs above; if you want shorter (48 hours) for any specific playbook items, flag them in the MAP and we can try to prioritize but not guaranteed.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
